basic_profile.bio: An enthusiastic hobbyist from Southern California, diving into the worlds of archery and tabletop gaming. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passions. A regular at local archery ranges and a big fan of the Anaheim Ducks, I balance my time between creative projects and outdoor activities. Not much of a morning person, I tend to be online late into the night. In a long-term relationship with a fellow geek, we often attend gaming conventions together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in archery through online resources and community forums. My interest in tabletop games led me to explore 'Warhammer 40K' extensively, gaining insights through YouTube tutorials and community discussions. My design skills were honed through online courses and practical freelance work.
